Project 2024/55/B/HS3/01985, synopsis p. 1, paragraphs 1–2. Regional group in the eastern Hrubieszów Basin from the late second to late fourth century CE.

summary.de: Gräber und Siedlungsspuren im Osten des Beckens von Hrubieszów. Besonders gut untersucht sind die Friedhöfe bei Masłomęcz und Gródek am Bug.
summary.en: Cemeteries and traces of settlements in the eastern Hrubieszów Basin. Burial grounds near Masłomęcz and at Gródek on the Bug are particularly well documented.
